program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (norm cells) (sort (normalize-cells cells) cell<?))
    (define (tri-color cells)
      (let ((n (norm cells)))
        (cond [(equal? n (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 0))) 2]
              [(equal? n (list (list 0 0) (list 0 1) (list 1 1))) 3]
              [(equal? n (list (list 0 0) (list 1 0) (list 1 1))) 4]
              [(equal? n (list (list 0 1) (list 1 0) (list 1 1))) 8]
              [else #f])))
    (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))])
      (let ((color (tri-color (obj-cells obj))))
        (if color (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) color) out)))))
